Education Classes, training and tips Find a Job Join our talented team Explore Services Find services near you Make a Referral Refer your patients to PHS Getting Started Because Every Kid Deserves To Be a Kid It’s our mission to provide care for kids with medical complexities in the comfort of their own homes. For kids, that means more time to be a kid. For parents and caregivers, our services offer you more time to focus on family. New patient? Getting Started Guide Services Respiratory Services Infusion Services Clinical Nutrition Nursing Services View All Services Most Trusted Pediatric Home Care Provider Find a Location Meet Our Kiddos & Watch Their Stories. Meet Garret Meet Garret He is 8, almost 9, and living life to its fullest at home and in his community. Garrett doesn’t let spina bifida slow him down. Meet Ireland Meet Ireland Ireland’s first reconstructive surgery for Long-Gap Congenital Esophageal Atresia failed, causing a massive infection; avoiding other infections while maintaining proper development were the primary goals for Ireland. PHS respiratory therapists provided heated humidity and oxygen support, as well as a feeding pump, trach-tube and nutrition supplies. Today, Ireland is thriving and is happy to be at home. Meet Emily Meet Emily Emily was born with omphalocele and a small thorax, which combined with the curvature of her spine doesn’t give her enough room to breathe. Eating is an issue. PHS respiratory therapists provided ventilator and oxygen support, while PHS dietitians managed g-tube feedings and oral supplements. Meet Easton Meet Easton Born at just 23 weeks, Easton was diagnosed with bronchopulmonary dysplasia. He required the support of respiratory therapy, enteral nutrition as well as home care nursing, and PHS was honored to help this family transition to home where they could all thrive Contact Us How can we help you? Our kind and caring staff are available to provide you with more information, answer your questions, and talk with you about our services. Pediatric Center of Excellence As a Pediatric Center of Excellence (PCoE), PHS has a commitment to help kids with medical complexities live life as fully as possible – at home, with their families. In combination with our mission and our guiding principles, PHS drives innovation in home care and supports access to quality care for our patient families by advancing the home care industry in each of these six petals. Get to know more about who we are and what we stand for by discovering each of the PCoE petals. Our Commitment to Taking Care of the Child® guides everything we do. We’re a team on mission: We make a difference in the life of every family we serve by taking care of the child, so that children with medical complexities can achieve their best lives at home and in their communities. At PHS, we embrace our mission, our guiding principles, and our focus on being a Pediatric Center of Excellence. We create an environment in which our patients and our employees succeed. Together, we will enhance the quality of life for children and improve access to care. Proudly Accredited We’re proud to be accredited by both CHAP (Community Health Accreditation Partner) and ACHC (Accreditation Commission for Health Care), two respected organizations recognized for their commitment to healthcare quality and safety These accreditations reflect our commitment to delivering the highest standards of care and operations. Through rigorous evaluations and continuous improvement, we ensure that our patients and their families receive safe, effective, and compassionate services they can trust. Guided by Our Principles PHS was founded on the belief that kids deserve to be kids and grow up at home – even if they have medical complexities. Since opening our doors more than 30 years ago with seven employees, this simple mission has helped tens of thousands of kids live their best lives in their homes and communities.
